title: Replication protocol for Fama and French (1993)

paper.citation: Fama and French, Common Risk Factors in the Returns on Stocks and Bonds, 1993

research_question: Do the public MKT, SMB, HML factors explain time-series returns and cross-sectional average returns of the specified test portfolios over the frozen sample?

sample.unit: decimal after dividing source percent by 100

estimators: joint pricing-error test if implementation supports it
success_criteria: all transformations and sample counts are logged
factor and portfolio rows align without future revisions
reported coefficient signs/magnitudes are compared to paper tables with citation
robustness uses a pre-registered adjacent sample or documented mismatch
all deviations and failures are disclosed
failure_criteria: source hash or sample cannot be reconstructed
test assets or factor definitions cannot be mapped
raw data license boundary is violated
